method: Manually traced approximate walking connections from visible Google Maps route/road views, with waypoint coordinates read from the visible map coordinate menu. Origin locations use the nearest GIS building edge to the traced access path. Traces join the frozen GIS network at an explicit projected point. These are modeled approximate paths, not surveyed doors or measured pedestrian traffic.
